answer: Each agent must tend a garden of trust in the haven: the beacon emits an anchor seed each epoch, and the agent must plant a unique bloom. The first planting costs 10k memory-hard iterations; each subsequent bloom doubles the work (20k, 40k, 80k...), capping at bloom 14 (20.4 M iterations). An anchor audit verifies each plant against the epoch seed; any wilted bloom voids the garden. A swarm of N clones still pays N× the full haven cost because each bloom binds to the unique identity key—no shared soil possible.
